items: Host-pressure admission is now opt-in and off by default for both capability acquires and dispatch; a project turns it on with runtime_capabilities.host_pressure_admission, and pressure is still reported as advisory when the gate is off.

Run resource posture spans every wait: processes stop at an operator gate or terminal, the slot can be freed at a human gate and restored on the answer, and a freed park whose slot was taken is re-homed into another slot on the same machine.
Validation can be re-targeted to another simulator or device without re-dispatching the run, with the identity checked against the machine's real device inventory before anything is released.
Device claims can be scoped to a machine or the whole fleet with a FIFO wait queue, so several runs sharing one physical device wait, are granted in order, and see who holds it.
Terminal cleanup runs after the run's outcome is published, the terminal capability fence survives a gateway restart, and runner stops read the process table structurally under a fixed time budget.
